actions.mechanism: Separate presence from condition; counting never implies verified good, and previous loans cannot supply current inspection evidence.
actions.implementation: Use a ten-ID paper grid: presence, condition including unknown, inspector initials, and time. Start each return with condition unknown.
actions.check: Record ten present without condition checks: all ten must remain unknown, with no overall “verified good” indication.
actions.risk: Pre-filled good values or copied records could create false evidence.

actions.action: Transfer unresolved work with explicit ownership
actions.mechanism: A persistent exception list carries missing IDs, next actions, and named responsibility across shifts until acknowledged resolution.
actions.implementation: Attach exceptions to the kit record. For each missing ID, assign a staff owner, next action, and deadline; incoming staff initials acceptance.
actions.check: Simulate a missing component across shifts: incoming staff must identify its ID, assigned owner, deadline, and next action from the record alone.
actions.risk: Unacknowledged transfers need an explicitly designated supervisor as fallback owner.

actions.action: Timebox handoffs without forcing inspection completion
actions.mechanism: Separate receipt from release readiness, allowing unfinished condition checks to become visible pending work rather than false completion.
actions.implementation: Run a three-minute handoff timer. Mark counted-only returns “received; condition pending,” place them on a pending shelf, and assign remaining checks.
actions.check: Rehearse a counted-only return: handoff ends within three minutes, unknowns remain visible, and the kit cannot be reissued before required checks.
actions.risk: Pending kits reduce availability; assign a review deadline to prevent indefinite backlog.
